# GEN — Auto Content Engine API (Full Reference)

> Exhaustive endpoint reference. This doc is organized around the **5-step journey**, not by resource, so every endpoint sits next to the endpoints it gets called alongside in real workflows.

For a teaching-style introduction with runnable curl chains, read `https://api.gen.pro/llms.txt` first. This file is the full spec.

## Canonical Vidsheet workflow

Start at https://api.gen.pro/guides/vidsheet-actions/ for `gen_discover` and `gen_vidsheet_action`: current field schemas, creation-card drafts, exact-owner generation, media prerequisites, retries, and deletion confirmation. Configure hosted MCP with `Authorization: Bearer <your-PAT>`; no per-session JWT minting is required.

Existing-job lifecycle is separate: `gen_vidsheet_action` op `continue_generation` (generation_id, agent_id, idempotency_key) continues an owned stopped job using credits, without a creation-card body. The key is nonblank, 1–255 characters, and may contain spaces. Retry the identical job, agent, and key after timeout or `generation_busy`; changed input under the same key conflicts. The response retains the same `generation_id` with status `pending`; poll it with the `gen_discover` generation view. This is not a promise to resume a provider's partial work.

Per-target Vidsheet mutation examples in this reference describe legacy direct-HTTP routes, not the canonical action contract. Migrate editing integrations to the guide. Hosted MCP does not provide final-video rendering; use the Vidsheet editor. Read-only and non-Vidsheet endpoint references remain applicable.
<!-- gen:backend-vidsheet-actions:start -->

`POST /v1/vidsheet/actions` takes one envelope: `actions[]` of 1–200 typed actions.

| `action` | `target.kind` | Required besides `action` and `target` |
|---|---|---|
| `create` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `create` | `column` | `values` |
| `create` | `row` | — |
| `create` | `layer` | — |
| `create` | `variable` | `values` |
| `update` | `vidsheet` | `values` |
| `update` | `column` | `values` |
| `update` | `row` | `values` |
| `update` | `cell` | `values` |
| `update` | `layer` | `values` |
| `update` | `creation_card` | `values` |
| `update` | `variable` | `values` |
| `generate` | `cell` | `card` |
| `generate` | `layer` | `card` |
| `generate` | `creation_card` | `card` |
| `generate` | `column` | — |
| `duplicate` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `duplicate` | `column` | — |
| `duplicate` | `row` | — |
| `duplicate` | `layer` | — |
| `delete` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `delete` | `column` | — |
| `delete` | `row` | — |
| `delete` | `layer` | — |
| `delete` | `variable` | — |
| `reorder` | `column` | `ids` |
| `reorder` | `row` | `ids` |
| `reorder` | `layer` | `ids` |
| `undo` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `redo` | `vidsheet` | — |
| `export` | `vidsheet` | — |

Read the current envelope with `GET /v1/vidsheet/action_schema` (MCP: `gen_discover` domain=`vidsheet` view=`actions`).
`Idempotency-Key`: Required for generate; optional for edits. Scoped to acting user and agent for 24 hours. Identical requests replay the stored response; changed requests conflict.
Existing-job lifecycle: `POST /v1/generations/{id}/lifecycle` (MCP: `gen_vidsheet_action` ops `stop_generation` and `continue_generation`).

Vidsheet operation history (undo and redo):

| Method | Path | `operationId` |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/v1/vidsheet/{vidsheet_id}/operations` | `vidsheet_operation.index` |
| GET | `/v1/vidsheet/{vidsheet_id}/operations/last` | `vidsheet_operation.last` |
| POST | `/v1/vidsheet/{vidsheet_id}/operations/redo` | `vidsheet_operation.redo` |
| POST | `/v1/vidsheet/{vidsheet_id}/operations/undo` | `vidsheet_operation.undo` |

<!-- gen:backend-vidsheet-actions:end -->

## Base URLs and Auth

- `https://api.gen.pro/v1` — agent setup, vidsheets, generations, renders, content monitoring, publishing
- `https://agent.gen.pro/v1` — content ideas, research, conversations, chat

Auth on both surfaces:
- `X-API-Key: <your-PAT>` — recommended; create via `POST /v1/persisted_tokens` or in the GEN dashboard
- `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>` — for browser-login apps

Vidsheet requests identify the acting `agent_id`. Canonical action requests carry it in the body; discovery uses a query parameter. Generation requires usable workspace credits; draft and property updates do not start generation.

Credits: paid generation/research/voice/render work spends workspace credits. Buy arbitrary credit amounts with x402 by calling `POST /v1/x402_credit_purchase` with `workspace_id` plus `amount_usd` or `credits`. If no `network` is supplied, the response lists every configured payment option in `payment_methods` and `payment_required.accepts`: Sui, Solana, and Base when configured. Show those options to the user/agent, sign one accept entry, then retry/settle with `PAYMENT-SIGNATURE`, `X402-Checkout-Session-Id`, and the chosen `X402-Network`. Workspace funding wallets are backend infrastructure; the user-facing wallet choices are the returned payment methods.

## OpenAPI

Full OpenAPI 3.1 spec: https://api.gen.pro/openapi.yaml. Every operation carries an `x-phase` extension set to one of: `setup`, `ideas`, `convert`, `edit`, `export`.

---

# Phase 1 — Setup

Everything you do once per agent: create the agent, configure identity / voice / personality / inspiration sources, set up API keys, manage workspaces.

## Discovery

```
GET /v1/me
→ { id, email, name, username, created_at }

GET /v1/workspaces
→ [{ id, name }]

GET /v1/agents?workspace_id={id}
→ [{ id, name }]
```

## Agents

```
POST /v1/agents
Body: { organization_id?, agent: { name, description?, time_zone?, eleven_lab_api_key?, hume_ai_api_key?, agent_avatars_attributes? } }
→ { agent: { id, name, description, organization_id, time_zone, primary_avatar_id, primary_avatar_url, role, default_user_voice } }
Errors: 422 agent_creation_failed, 422 organization_not_found, 422 invalid_api_key

GET /v1/agents/{id}?with_organization_uuid=true
→ { id, name, description, organization_id, time_zone, primary_avatar_id, primary_avatar_url, agent_setup_project_id, role, default_user_voice: { id, name, gender, language, provider, url } }
Errors: 403 permission_denied, 422 agent_not_found

PATCH /v1/agents/{id}
Body: { agent: { name?, description?, time_zone?, eleven_lab_api_key?, hume_ai_api_key?, agent_avatars_attributes?, default_user_voice_attributes?: { source, voice_id } } }
→ updated agent
Errors: 403 permission_denied, 404 user_voice_resource_not_found, 422 agent_not_found, 422 validation_error, 422 invalid_api_key, 422 voice_id_required

DELETE /v1/agents/{id}
→ 200 empty
Errors: 403 forbidden

GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/avatars?cursor={cursor}
→ [{ id, is_primary, url, thumbnail_url, degod_avatar_id }]  (20/page, cursor pagination)

POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/avatars
Body (multipart): agent_avatars_attributes[]: { file (JPEG/PNG/WebP) or degod_avatar_id }
→ 200 empty
Errors: 422 avatar_creation_failed

PATCH /v1/agents/{agent_id}/avatars/{id}
Marks avatar primary; all others non-primary.
→ 200 empty
Errors: 422 avatar_update_failed

DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/avatars/{id}
id may be underscore-joined for multi-delete (e.g. "7_8_9").
→ 200 empty
```

## Agent Core (preferred single-call setup)

**Use this for all agent setup reads and writes.** Flat endpoint. Every field name mirrors the GEN Setup canvas.

### Three critical distinctions

- `linked_accounts` = agent's OWN brand socials (what it posts from)
- `monitored` = inspiration sources (creators / hashtags / keywords to watch)
- `research_topics` = expertise areas the platform researches daily (labeled "Expertise" in UI)
- `description` = 2-3 sentence summary (max 500 chars)
- `personality` = full persona text (max 20000 chars)

### GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/core

```json
{
  "agent_id": "abc123",
  "brand_name": "Santiago",
  "description": "San Antonio street food scout who hunts the best tacos.",
  "identity_type": "character",
  "goal": "growth",
  "target_platforms": ["tiktok", "instagram"],
  "shortform": true,
  "longform": false,
  "onboarding_status": "profile_complete",
  "keywords": ["streetfood", "tacotok", "sanantonioeats"],
  "monitored": [
    { "handle": "https://tiktok.com/@keilapacheco", "item_type": "account" },
    { "handle": "tacotok", "item_type": "hashtag" }
  ],
  "research_topics": [
    { "topic": "new food truck openings in San Antonio" }
  ],
  "linked_accounts": [
    { "id": 42, "url": "https://tiktok.com/@santiago_real", "platform": "tiktok", "display_name": "Santiago" }
  ],
  "personality": "Santiago grew up eating at his tia taco stand in south San Antonio...",
  "default_user_voice": { "voice_id": "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM", "name": "Rachel", "source": "public" }
}
```

### PATCH /v1/agents/{agent_id}/core

Flat merge-patch. Send only the fields you want to change. Unknown fields return 422.

Field-level semantics:
- Scalars replace: `brand_name`, `description`, `identity_type`, `goal`, `shortform`, `longform`, `onboarding_status`, `personality`
- List fields use FULL replacement (missing = deleted): `keywords`, `target_platforms`, `monitored`, `research_topics`, `linked_accounts`
- `linked_accounts` diffing: rows with `id` are updated in place, rows without `id` are inserted, rows absent from the list are deleted. To add one row without touching others: GET, append, PATCH.
- `default_user_voice` replaces

Keyword auto-mirror: sending `keywords` without `monitored` auto-populates `monitored` with `[{ handle: kw, item_type: "keyword" }]`.

Validation:
- `description` max 500 chars
- `personality` max 20000 chars
- `identity_type` enum: `"brand"` | `"character"`
- `monitored[].item_type` enum: `"account"` | `"hashtag"` | `"keyword"`
- `research_topics` max 20 items, each `topic` max 500 chars
- `linked_accounts[].url` required
- All nested objects reject unknown keys

Response: `200` on full success. On partial failure, `207 Multi-Status` with per-section results:

```json
{
  "brand":       { "status": "ok", "data": { "brand_name": "Santiago", ... } },
  "personality": { "status": "ok", "data": "Santiago grew up..." },
  "voice":       { "status": "error", "error": "voice service unavailable" }
}
```

Example:

```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.gen.pro/v1/agents/abc123/core" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "brand_name": "Santiago",
    "description": "San Antonio street food scout who hunts the best tacos.",
    "identity_type": "character",
    "goal": "growth",
    "target_platforms": ["tiktok", "instagram"],
    "shortform": true,
    "longform": false,
    "keywords": ["streetfood", "tacotok", "sanantonioeats"],
    "monitored": [
      { "handle": "https://tiktok.com/@keilapacheco", "item_type": "account" }
    ],
    "research_topics": [
      { "topic": "new food truck openings in San Antonio" }
    ],
    "linked_accounts": [
      { "url": "https://tiktok.com/@santiago_real", "platform": "tiktok", "display_name": "Santiago" }
    ],
    "personality": "Santiago grew up eating at his tia taco stand...",
    "default_user_voice": { "voice_id": "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM", "source": "public" }
  }'
```

## Voice API (Agent Core sub-surface)

All under `/v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/*`. PAT auth.

### Library

```
GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/library?source={public|user_designed|user_trained|user_elevenlabs}

→ {
  "voices": [
    { "voice_id": "21m00...", "name": "Rachel",  "source": "public",        "preview_url": null },
    { "voice_id": "huv-1",    "name": "Custom",  "source": "user_designed", "preview_url": null },
    { "voice_id": "huv-2",    "name": "Clone 1", "source": "user_trained",  "preview_url": null }
  ],
  "total": 3
}
```

### ElevenLabs integration

Users connect their own ElevenLabs API key to unlock their personal voice library and use their own quota.

```
GET    /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/integrations/elevenlabs          → { connected, masked_key }
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/integrations/elevenlabs          Body: { api_key } → { connected: true, user: { subscription } }
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/integrations/elevenlabs/test     Body: { api_key } → { valid }  (no save)
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/integrations/elevenlabs          → { connected: false }
```

### Voice design — 4-step prompt-based flow

Build a voice from a text description. Steps 1-3 are cheap; step 4 persists.

```
1. POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/design/generate-script
   Body: { language? }
   → { voice_sample: "..." }

2. POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/design/generate-description
   Body: { gender (required), voice_description?, language?, script? }
   → { voice_description: "..." }

3. POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/design/generate-samples
   Body: { text (required), description? }
   → { samples: [{ generation_id, audio }, { generation_id, audio }, { generation_id, audio }] }

4. POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/design
   Body: { generation_id (required), name (required), gender?, language?, description? }
   → created voice resource
```

`generation_id` is opaque. Don't parse or store it beyond step 4.

### Voice cloning (synchronous)

```
POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/clone
Body variant A (preferred): { name (required), audio_url,    gender?, language?, description? }
Body variant B (inline):    { name (required), audio_base64, gender?, language?, description? }
```

Exactly one of `audio_url` / `audio_base64`. Small clips only for base64; prefer audio_url for files.

### Voice delete + preview

```
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/{voice_id}                      — delete user-owned voice
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/{voice_id}/preview              Body: { text } — **ASYNC**. → { user_job_id }
GET    /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/preview/{job_id}                — poll the preview
   When status == "completed", audio URL is in output_resources.
```

## Organizations (Workspaces)

```
GET /v1/organizations
→ [{ id, uuid, organization_id, name, avatar: { url, thumbnail_url }, user_role, credit, available_credit: { generic, aura }, total_members, credit_plan: { id, name, cycle } }]

POST /v1/organizations
Body: { organization: { name, avatar? (file) } }
→ { organization_id }
Errors: 422 validation_error

GET /v1/organizations/{organization_id}
→ { id, uuid, organization_id, name, avatar, user_role, credit, available_credit, total_members, credit_plan }
Errors: 422 organization_not_found

PATCH /v1/organizations/{organization_id}
Body: { organization: { name?, avatar? (file) } }
Errors: 403 forbidden (not owner/manager), 422 organization_not_found, 422 validation_error

DELETE /v1/organizations/{organization_id}
Permanent. Owner role required. Irreversible.
Errors: 403 forbidden (not owner), 422 organization_not_found
```

## API Keys

```
POST /v1/persisted_tokens
Body: { name?, expires_in? }
→ { id, name, token_type, status, token }   (token shown once)

GET /v1/persisted_tokens
→ [{ id, name, token_type, created_at, expires_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, status }]

PATCH /v1/persisted_tokens/{id}
Body: { persisted_token: { name } }

DELETE /v1/persisted_tokens/{id}/revoke
DELETE /v1/persisted_tokens/revoke_all
```

# Phase 2 — Ideas

Everything related to proposing and refining video ideas backed by real trending data.

**Base URL for this phase:** `https://agent.gen.pro/v1` (plus content monitoring on `api.gen.pro`).

## Runs (trigger ideas, refine, chat, set preferences)

Same endpoint for every intent — the natural-language `message` determines what the agent does.

```
POST /v1/agent/run
Body: {
  message,
  agent_id,
  conversation_id?,      // omit to start a new conversation; pass to refine
  attachments?,          // optional URLs for vision grounding
  context?: { vidsheet_id? },
  debug?
}
→ { run_id, conversation_id, status: "running", progress_stream_url }
```

Message patterns:
- Generate ideas: `"Generate 5 content ideas grounded in this weeks trends"` (no conversation_id → new conv)
- Refine: pass `conversation_id`, `"Make idea 1 punchier. Drop idea 3."`
- Set preference: `"remember: always use statement hooks, never questions"`
- Remove preference: `"forget: that rule about statement hooks"`
- Simple chat: `"What performed best last week in my niche?"`

```
GET /v1/agent/runs/{run_id}
→ { run_id, conversation_id, status: "running" | "completed" | "failed", messages: [{ role, content, data }] }

POST /v1/agent/runs/{run_id}/approve         — approve or reject a pending action. Body: { approved: true|false }
```

Live progress:
- Use the `progress_stream_url` returned by `POST /v1/agent/run` as the run-specific progress channel. Treat it as an opaque, sensitive URL — do not share it; it carries that run's live updates.
- Channel keys: `status`, `plan` (numbered checklist), `thinking`, `messages`
- Or poll `GET /v1/agent/runs/{run_id}` until `status == "completed"` for a fully authenticated path.

## Song Mixes

Backend/API-first contract for combining multiple songs into one long DJ-style audio output.

```
POST /v1/audio/mixes
Body: {
  tracks?: [{ title?, artist?, url?, asset_id?, bpm?, key?, mood? }],
  prompt?,
  transition_style?,
  output_format?: "mp3" | "wav",
  auto_order?: true,
  desired_duration_seconds?,
  generate_missing_count?
}
→ {
  job_id,
  status: "pending_engine" | "pending_song_generation",
  prompt,
  tracks,
  engine: "mixxx_or_compatible",
  output_format,
  transition_style,
  auto_order,
  desired_duration_seconds,
  output_url: null,
  message,
  next_step
}
```

Default prompt:

```text
Mix these 5 songs in the optimal order for the best flow and energy:

[Your 5 songs]

Analyze BPM, key, and mood, then arrange them for the smoothest possible DJ mix with professional transitions.
```

The contract is live now. Until the Mixxx-compatible renderer worker is installed, the API returns `pending_engine` and does not fabricate an `output_url`.

## Conversations

```
GET    /v1/agent/conversations?agent_id={id}
→ { conversations: [{ id, agent_id, title, pinned, created_at, updated_at, run_count }] }

GET    /v1/agent/conversations/{id}                    — conversation metadata
GET    /v1/agent/conversations/{id}/messages           — all messages (chronological)
GET    /v1/agent/conversations/{id}/runs               — all runs in the conversation
GET    /v1/agent/conversations/{id}/session-preferences  — read per-conversation prefs → { preferences }
PATCH  /v1/agent/conversations/{id}/session-preferences  — set per-conversation prefs; Body: { preferences }
PATCH  /v1/agent/conversations/{id}                    — Body: { title?, pinned? }
DELETE /v1/agent/conversations/{id}                    — deletes conversation, runs, messages
```

## Content Ideas

Ideas produced by runs are first-class records.

```
GET /v1/agent/ideas?agent_id={id}&status={status}
→ [{
  id, idea_id, agent_id,
  title, hook, full_script, description,
  video_type, video_type_id, status,
  estimated_duration, aspect_ratio,
  data: {
    selected_assets: [ { url, type, description, usage, source, clip_range: { start, end } } ],
    project_manifest: {
      video_title, total_duration, aspect_ratio,
      global_extracted_assets: [...],
      timeline_layers: [...]
    },
    inspiration_sources: [ { type, url, creator, watch_count, like_count, what_was_used } ],
    rationale
  },
  created_at
}]

POST /v1/agent/ideas/{id}/status                       — cycle to next status
PUT  /v1/agent/ideas/{id}/status/{status}              — set explicit status
POST /v1/ideas/{id}/expand                             — expand idea into a project_manifest (idempotent; note: no /agent/ segment)
```

Status flow: `generated → approve_to_create → ready_for_review → approved_to_post → posted`

Edit/rejection statuses: `change_idea`, `change_video`, `rejected`.

Video type IDs: `0=Any, 1=Talking Avatar, 2=Green Screen, 3=Montage, 4=Text-Driven, 5=POV Object, 6=Narrated/VO, 8=Split Screen, 9=Skit`.

## Research (standalone)

```
POST /v1/research
Body: { topic, depth: "quick" | "default" | "deep", agent_id }
→ { run_id, conversation_id, status: "running", progress_stream_url }
```

Poll `GET /v1/agent/runs/{run_id}` until `status` is `completed`. Completed messages contain the structured research findings and summary.

Depths: `quick`, `default`, `deep`.

## Research topics (daily background research)

Configured via Agent Core (`research_topics` field). The platform researches each topic daily and feeds findings into the Ideas Engine automatically. No poll needed — just set topics and consume ideas downstream.

## Content Monitoring (trending data into agent knowledge base)

**Base URL for this sub-surface:** `https://api.gen.pro/v1`

```
POST /v1/user_jobs?agent_id={id}
Content-Type: multipart/form-data
Body:
  - user_job[user_job_type] = "train_social"
  - user_job[data] = JSON string:
      platform (required):   "tiktok" | "instagram" | "youtube"
      type (required):       "username" | "hashtag" | "keyword"   (not all combos supported)
      value (required):      @creator, #topic, or plain text
      days:                  0 | 1 | 7 | 30 | 90 | 180
      country:               two-letter code (us, gb, etc.)
      max_results:           1-50
      monitoring:            false (default, one-time) | true (ongoing)
      comment_monitoring:    true | false
→ { user_job_id }

PUT /v1/user_jobs/{id}?agent_id={id}
Flat params: platform, type, value, days, country, max_results, monitoring, comment_monitoring
Only pending/processing jobs can be updated.
```

### Platform capabilities

| Platform | Username | Hashtag | Keyword |
|----------|----------|---------|---------|
| TikTok | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Instagram | Yes | Yes | No |
| YouTube | Yes | Yes | Yes |

### Pricing

Per video/post: $0.015. Per comment (when enabled): $0.002.

### Reading scraped data

No raw data dump endpoint — query through the agent:
- **Agent Chat**: `POST /v1/agent/run` with natural-language questions
- **Automation Pipelines**: scheduled prompts that populate vidsheet rows with results

Status flow: `pending → processing → completed` (one-time) or stays `processing` (monitoring). Poll `GET /v1/user_jobs/{id}?agent_id={id}`.

---

# Phase 3 — Convert

Everything related to taking an idea and producing an Auto Content Engine (vidsheet) to work it in.

## Templates

Templates are pre-configured engines synced from a curated library. Cloning is the 80% path.

```
GET /v1/templates/projects?page={page}
→ [{ id, slug, title, name, description, cover, tutorial_url, tags: [], recent_generated_contents: [{ id, type, thumbnail_url }] }]
(20/page, page starts at 1.)

GET /v1/templates/projects/{slug}
slug can be a URL slug, UUID, or numeric ID.
→ full template definition with columns, layer stacks, recent renders

POST /v1/templates/spreadsheets/{slug}/clone
Body: { agent_id }
→ full engine object with columns, rows, cells, layer stack
```

Default template columns: TEXT 1, TEXT 2, PROMPT (ingredient), VIDEO, FINAL VIDEO, STATS.

Cloning is **free** — no credits consumed.

## Auto Content Engine (create from scratch)

If no template matches, build manually.

Duplicate an existing Vidsheet through `gen_vidsheet_action` after
`gen_discover`; use `action=duplicate` with `target.kind=vidsheet`.

```
POST /v1/vidsheet?agent_id={id}
Body: { spreadsheet: { title, is_default? } }
→ full engine with empty columns / rows

GET /v1/vidsheet/{id}?agent_id={id}&with_execution_cost=true
→ full engine with nested spreadsheet_columns, spreadsheet_rows (each with spreadsheet_cells), global_variables_sheet

PATCH /v1/vidsheet/{id}?agent_id={id}
Body: { project: { title, is_default? } }
→ renamed engine (no nested columns / rows)

DELETE /v1/vidsheet/{id}?agent_id={id}
→ 200, empty body; deletes the engine with all columns, rows, cells, layers, variables and automations (not undoable)
```

---

# Phase 4 — Edit

Everything related to filling the vidsheet: cells, layers, creation cards, generations, variables, assets, automation.

Duplicate a Vidsheet, row, column, or layer through `gen_vidsheet_action`
after `gen_discover`; per-target duplicate routes are not the current
user-facing contract.

## Rows

```
GET    /v1/vidsheet/{id}/rows?agent_id={id}
POST   /v1/vidsheet/{id}/rows?agent_id={id}                Body: { spreadsheet_row: { position? } }
GET    /v1/vidsheet/{id}/rows/{row_id}?agent_id={id}
PUT    /v1/vidsheet/{id}/rows/update_positions?agent_id={id}   Body: { rows: [{ id, position }] }
PUT    /v1/vidsheet/{id}/rows/mass_update?agent_id={id}
```

## Columns

Only `ingredient` role columns can be created / updated / deleted by users. System roles (`video`, `final_video`, `stats`, `global_variable_*`) are platform-managed.

Types: `text`, `image`, `video`, `audio`.

```
GET    /v1/vidsheet/{id}/columns?agent_id={id}
POST   /v1/vidsheet/{id}/columns?agent_id={id}               Body: { spreadsheet_column: { title, type, position? } }
PATCH  /v1/vidsheet/{id}/columns/update_positions?agent_id={id}
PUT    /v1/vidsheet/{id}/columns/mass_update?agent_id={id}
```

## Cells

```
GET    /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}?agent_id={id}
PATCH  /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}?agent_id={id}       Body: { spreadsheet_cell: { value } }
PUT    /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/mass_update?agent_id={id}
PATCH  /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}/set_default_user_job?agent_id={id}   Body: { user_job_id }
```

## Layers

Per-cell timeline elements. `position` is z-index.

```
POST   /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}/layers?agent_id={id}       Body: { video_layer: { name, type, position? } }
GET    /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}/layers/{layer_id}?agent_id={id}
PATCH  /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}/layers/{layer_id}?agent_id={id}
DELETE /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}/layers/{layer_id}?agent_id={id}
PUT    .../layers/update_positions?agent_id={id}
```

## Generations (trigger + poll)

```
POST /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}/generate?agent_id={id}
Body: { generation_type, data: { ... } }
→ { generation_id, status: "pending" }

POST /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}/layers/{layer_id}/generate?agent_id={id}
Body: { generation_type, data: { ... } }
→ { generation_id, status: "pending" }

GET /v1/generations/{id}
→ { id, status, user_job_type, result, output_resources: [{ id, url, thumbnail_url, object_type }] }

POST /v1/generations/{id}/stop       — credits refunded; status → "stopped"
POST /v1/generations/{id}/continue   — credits re-charged; status → "pending"
```

Status flow: `pending → processing → completed | failed | stopped`.

## Creation-card capability matrix (generated from the API)

The creation-card capability matrix: the model ids each creation card accepts, and the ratio, duration and outputResolution values the API runs. A generation outside those values is refused.

| Card | Model | Label | Ratio | Duration (s) | Output resolution |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image-from-text` | `gemini_2` | Nano Banana 2 | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | — | — |
| `image-from-text` | `gemini_2_lite` | Nano Banana 2 Lite | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | — | — |
| `image-from-text` | `gemini_pro` | Nano Banana Pro | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | — | — |
| `image-from-text` | `gpt-image-2` | GPT Image 2 | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | — | — |
| `image-from-text` | `gpt-image-2.5-flare` | GPT Image 2.5 Flare | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | — | — |
| `image-from-text` | `gpt-image-2.5-sunburst` | GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst | `1:1`, `9:16`, `16:9` | — | — |
| `image-from-text` | `grok` | Grok | `1:1`, `16:9`, `9:16`, `4:3`, `3:4`, `3:2`, `2:3` | — | — |

## Creation Card Types (exact `generation_type` + `data`)

### text

```
generation_type: "text"
Models: openai, gemini
data: { prompt, model, variables: { key: value } }
Output: text string in cell value
```

### image_from_text

```
generation_type: "image_from_text"
Models: gemini, gemini_pro, gemini_2, gemini_2_lite, imagen, seedream-4.0, seedream-4.5, gpt-image-2, gpt-image-2.5-flare, gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, midjourney, grok
Version (model gemini only): nano-banana/nano-banana-pro/nano-banana-2/nano-banana-2-lite
Aspect ratios: "1:1", "9:16", "16:9", "4:3", "3:4"; grok also supports "3:2", "2:3"
data: { prompt, model, aspect_ratio, variables }
Output: image content resource
```

### video_from_text

```
generation_type: "video_from_text"
Models: veo-3, veo-3-fast, veo-3.1, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite, gemini-omni-flash-preview, kling-v3, seedance-lite, seedance-pro, seedance-1.0-lite, seedance-1.0-pro, seedance-1.5-pro, seedance-2.0, seedance-2.5, grok
Aspect ratios: "1:1", "9:16", "16:9"; grok also supports "4:3", "3:4", "3:2", "2:3"
Durations (seconds): veo-3, veo-3-fast, veo-3.1, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite (4|6|8s); gemini-omni-flash-preview (1–10s); kling-v3; seedance-lite, seedance-pro, seedance-1.0-lite, seedance-1.0-pro, seedance-1.5-pro (3–12s); seedance-2.0 (4–15s); seedance-2.5 (4–15s); grok (1–15s)
data: { prompt, negative_prompt?, model, aspect_ratio, resolution?, duration, native_audio?, variables }
Resolution values: `1080p` or `720p` when supported by the selected model. Native audio is optional and defaults to false when omitted.
Output: video content resource
```

### video_from_image

```
generation_type: "video_from_image"
Models: veo-3, veo-3-fast, veo-3.1, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite, gemini-omni-flash-preview, kling-v3, kling-v2-6, seedance-lite, seedance-pro, seedance-1.0-lite, seedance-1.0-pro, seedance-1.5-pro, seedance-2.0, seedance-2.5, grok
Durations (seconds): veo-3, veo-3-fast, veo-3.1, veo-3.1-fast, veo-3.1-lite (4|6|8s); gemini-omni-flash-preview (1–10s); kling-v3, kling-v2-6; seedance-lite, seedance-pro, seedance-1.0-lite, seedance-1.0-pro, seedance-1.5-pro (3–12s); seedance-2.0 (4–15s); seedance-2.5 (4–15s); grok (1–15s)
data: { prompt, negative_prompt?, model, image_resource_id, image_tail_resource_id?, aspect_ratio, resolution?, duration, native_audio? }
Resolution values: `1080p` or `720p` when supported by the selected model. Native audio is optional and defaults to false when omitted.
Output: video content resource
```

### video_from_ingredients

```
generation_type: "video_from_ingredients"
Model: pika
data: { prompt, images: [{ value: "<uri>" }, ...], native_audio? }
prompt and images are required; no other fields are accepted.
Output: video content resource
```

### speech_from_text

```
generation_type: "speech_from_text"
data: { text, voice_id, enhance_voice?, remove_silence? }
text: 1–4000 chars. voice_id: a saved voice (GET /v1/agents/{agent_id}/voice/library).
Designing or cloning a voice are separate jobs (design_voice, clone_voice), not modes of this one.
Output: audio content resource
```

### lipsync

```
generation_type: "lipsync"
data: { talking_avatar_video_data: { video: { value: "<uri>" }, audio?: { value: "<uri>" } },
        voice_generation_data?: { text, voice_id, ... },   # same shape as speech_from_text data
        lip_sync_model?: "sync.so" | "gen",                 # default "gen"
        remove_background?, remove_silence? }
talking_avatar_video_data.video.value is required; supply speech as audio.value or voice_generation_data.
Output: video content resource with synced lip movements
```

### captions

```
generation_type: "captions"
Pass exactly one source. audio and video are mutually exclusive.
data (audio url): { audio: { value: "<uri>" }, trim?: { start_seconds, duration_seconds } }
data (video url): { video: { value: "<uri>" }, trim?: { start_seconds, duration_seconds } }
Output: caption layer with timed segments (result.captions, full_text, audio_duration)
```

### transcription

```
generation_type: "transcription"
Pass exactly one source. audio and video are mutually exclusive.
data (audio url): { audio: { value: "<uri>", key? }, trim?: { start_seconds, duration_seconds } }
data (video url): { video: { value: "<uri>", key? }, trim?: { start_seconds, duration_seconds } }
data (uploaded):  { content_resource_id }
trim.start_seconds >= 0; trim.duration_seconds > 0.
Output (in generation `result`):
  { full_text: "<entire transcript>",
    sentences: [{ text, startMs, endMs }],
    audio_duration: <seconds> }
Uses credits based on the duration of audio transcribed. Pre-charged on create, refunded on failure.
Use `captions` instead when you need word-level timings for subtitle overlays on a video.
```

Also available standalone, without a sheet or cell:

```
POST /v1/transcriptions?agent_id={id}
Body: { "data": { ... same shape as above ... } }
→ 201 { generation_id, status: "pending" }
Errors: 422 { error, error_code: "validation_error" }          (no source, both audio and video, bad uri, bad trim)
        422 { error, error_code: "insufficient_credits_for_job" }

Poll GET /v1/generations/{generation_id} until status is "completed", then read `result`.
```

### song

```
generation_type: "song"
data: { prompt, model?, duration?, instrumental?, style?, title?, negative_tags?, vocal_gender?,
        source_audio_resource_id?, source_audio_url?, audio_weight? }
prompt: what the song is about, plus any lyric direction, up to 5000 chars.
model: "suno-v5-beta" (default) | "suno-v4.5plus-beta" | "suno-v5.5-beta", each with its own duration ceiling.
duration: target seconds, default the model maximum — 240 (suno-v5-beta), 480 (suno-v4.5plus-beta), 360 (suno-v5.5-beta); clamped to the ceiling.
instrumental: true generates a track with no vocals (default false).
style: style/genre/mood, up to 1000 chars. title: up to 80 chars.
negative_tags: styles or instruments to avoid, up to 500 chars. vocal_gender: "m" | "f".
Source audio (audio-to-audio cover / style match), at most one of:
  source_audio_resource_id: an existing audio content resource id.
  source_audio_url: a public HTTPS URL, imported as a content resource first (the MCP gen_generate create_song action),
    or reference_audio.value / reference_audio_url in card data.
  audio_weight: 0.0–1.0 fidelity to the source.
Source audio is capped at 8 minutes (480 s); longer input is refused before any charge.
custom_mode is set for you when style, negative_tags, vocal_gender, instrumental, model or duration is non-default.
Output: audio content resource
```

Uploaded media is a cell value, not a generation:
`PATCH /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}` with `{ "spreadsheet_cell": { "value": "<url>" } }`.

### render (composite)

See Phase 5 — it's the export step.

## Global Variables

Template substitution for `{{variable_name}}` across prompts and cells.

```
GET  /v1/vidsheet/{id}/global_variables?agent_id={id}
POST /v1/vidsheet/{id}/import_global_variables?agent_id={id}      (multipart XLSX upload)
GET  /v1/vidsheet/global_variables_template                        (XLSX template download)
```

## Content Resources (upload and manage assets)

```
GET /v1/content_resources?agent_id={id}&type={image|video|audio|zip|safe_tensors}&project_id={id}&ids[]={id}&page={page}
→ [{ id, url, thumbnail_url, file_name, content_type }]          (20/page, page starts at 0)

POST /v1/content_resources?agent_id={id}
Body (multipart): content_resource[file] (required), asset_folder[id]?
→ { content_resource: {...}, generator: null }
Errors: 403 forbidden, 422 content_resource_creation_failed

GET    /v1/content_resources/{id}?agent_id={id}
→ { content_resource: {...}, generator: { id, status, type } | null }
   generator is null for manual uploads; populated for AI-generated resources.

PATCH  /v1/content_resources/{id}?agent_id={id}    Body: { content_resource: { filename } }
DELETE /v1/content_resources/{id}?agent_id={id}
```

### Asset Library (files + folders, unified view)

```
GET /v1/asset_libraries?agent_id={id}&folder_id={id}&asset_type={image,video,audio,folder}&search={q}&order={recent}&page={p}&page_size={s}
→ [
  { id, type: "AssetFolder", name },
  { id, type: "ContentResource", url, thumbnail_url, file_name, content_type }
]
```

### Asset folders

```
POST   /v1/asset_folders?agent_id={id}       Body: { asset_folder: { name, parent_id? } }
PATCH  /v1/asset_folders/{id}?agent_id={id}  Body: { asset_folder: { name } }
DELETE /v1/asset_folders/{id}?agent_id={id}  — deletes folder AND all contents (subfolders + files)
```

### Direct Upload (large files, up to 1 GB)

```
POST /v1/direct_upload
Body: { blob: { filename, byte_size (max 1GB), checksum (base64 MD5), content_type, metadata? } }
→ { id, key, filename, content_type, byte_size, checksum, signed_id, direct_upload: { url, headers: { Content-Type, Content-MD5 } } }

Workflow:
  1. POST /v1/direct_upload
  2. PUT file to direct_upload.url with the returned headers
  3. POST /v1/content_resources?agent_id={id} with signed_id as content_resource[file]

Compute checksum: openssl md5 -binary file | base64
```

## Proof of Genesis / Backup to Blockchain (`https://agent-core.gen.pro/v1`)

Proof of Genesis backs up assets from the GEN assets page or vidsheet workflows to Walrus and records proof metadata. It supports manual add/remove and automatic backup of selected asset events.

Privacy rule: Walrus blobs are public by default and blob IDs are not secrets. Public assets can be uploaded raw. Private assets must be encrypted before upload; raw private requests are rejected before billing or Walrus work.

Agent Core auto-backup fields:

```
proof_of_genesis_enabled: boolean
proof_of_genesis_auto_backup_sources: ["generated"|"uploaded"|"downloaded"|"published"]
proof_of_genesis_auto_backup_asset_types: ["video"|"image"]
```

Default auto-backup sources are `downloaded` and `published` when the paid feature is enabled.

Endpoints:

```
GET    /v1/agents/{agent_id}/proof-of-genesis/backups?include_removed=false
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/proof-of-genesis/backups
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/proof-of-genesis/backups/{backup_id}
```

`ProofOfGenesisBackupRequest`:

```json
{
  "asset_url": "https://assets.gen.pro/final.mp4",
  "video_url": null,
  "asset_type": "video",
  "visibility": "public",
  "encrypted": false,
  "encryption_scheme": null,
  "encryption_key_id": null,
  "owner_sui_address": "0x0e2f1e8a66445cfecff32e1e3ea3f8632c89aef4808e49acf318247850498f38",
  "source_event": "manual",
  "content_type": "video/mp4",
  "idempotency_key": "content-resource-4821-v1",
  "metadata": {
    "content_resource_id": 4821,
    "vidsheet_id": "vs_123",
    "row_id": "row_456"
  }
}
```

Enums:

- `asset_type`: `video`, `image`
- `visibility`: `private`, `public`
- `source_event`: `manual`, `generated`, `uploaded`, `downloaded`, `published`
- `encrypted`: required as `true` with `encryption_scheme` when `visibility` is `private`
- `owner_sui_address`: optional customer Sui wallet address that should own the Walrus object. Server-triggered auto-backup can resolve this from the user's Dynamic Sui wallet.

`ProofOfGenesisBackup` response:

```json
{
  "id": 101,
  "agent_id": "agent_123",
  "status": "synced",
  "source_event": "manual",
  "source_url": "https://assets.gen.pro/final.mp4",
  "asset_type": "video",
  "visibility": "public",
  "encrypted": false,
  "encryption_scheme": null,
  "encryption_key_id": null,
  "owner_sui_address": "0x0e2f1e8a66445cfecff32e1e3ea3f8632c89aef4808e49acf318247850498f38",
  "custody_mode": "customer_wallet",
  "walrus_object_recipient_address": "0x0e2f1e8a66445cfecff32e1e3ea3f8632c89aef4808e49acf318247850498f38",
  "content_sha256": "5ab58f4c35444f46c7df3788c49edd5fed2c97a57326ad2f32e4f45ace643842",
  "size_bytes": 4556,
  "content_type": "video/mp4",
  "walrus_blob_id": "PqwnXdU4n3cHGsbShjuPm9aGldSHCuXoovhi42IY-X8",
  "walrus_blob_object_id": "0x9afe196fbd99a3928875e7991...",
  "walrus_storage_id": "0xe2b5917464b74191f59d0bb1...",
  "walrus_end_epoch": 420,
  "walrus_encoded_length_bytes": 66034000,
  "verification_status": "verified",
  "billing_operation": "backup_to_blockchain",
  "billing_charge_id": 42,
  "billing_outboxed": false,
  "expires_at": "2026-07-03T16:00:08Z",
  "renewal_due_at": "2026-06-30T16:00:08Z",
  "renewal_status": "not_due",
  "renewal_attempts": 0,
  "last_renewed_at": null,
  "removed_at": null,
  "created_at": "2026-06-05T16:00:00Z",
  "completed_at": "2026-06-05T16:00:08Z"
}
```

Semantics:

- `POST` rejects raw private assets before billing, checks Rails credit balance before Walrus work, and charges operation `backup_to_blockchain` after successful upload/readback verification.
- If `owner_sui_address` is present, Agent Core asks the GEN Walrus publisher to transfer the Walrus object to that customer Sui wallet. Response rows expose `custody_mode` and `walrus_object_recipient_address`.
- Storage is monthly by default: new blobs are written for two Walrus epochs (~28 days), Rails billing receives GB-month usage units, and renewal is due three days before `expires_at`.
- Use `idempotency_key` for retries so the same asset event does not double upload or double bill.
- `GET` hides rows with `removed_at` unless `include_removed=true`.
- `DELETE` sets `removed_at` and hides the row from the default assets-page view; it does not guarantee deletion from Walrus or Sui.

## Automation

```
GET   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/automation_config
PATCH /v1/agents/{agent_id}/automation_config    Body: { automation_config: { webhook_url?, callback_url?, polling_enabled? } }

POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/automation_config/test_webhook
POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/automation_config/test_callback
```

Once configured, generations POST status updates to your `webhook_url`.

---

# Phase 5 — Export

Render the final composite, poll to completion, download the MP4, optionally publish to TikTok.

## Render the Final Video

Render is an async generation — same polling pattern as every other generation.

```
POST /v1/vidsheet/{id}/cells/{cell_id}/render?agent_id={id}
→ { generation_id, status: "pending" }
```

The target `cell_id` is the cell in the `final_video` column for a given row. That cell composites all layers on its row's video cell.

### Polling the render

```
GET /v1/generations/{generation_id}
```

Status flow:

```
pending → processing → completed | failed
```

On `completed`:

```json
{
  "id": 56789,
  "status": "completed",
  "output_resources": [
    {
      "id": 4821,
      "url": "https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/render_xyz.mp4",
      "thumbnail_url": "https://cdn.gen.pro/thumbnails/render_xyz.jpg",
      "object_type": "video"
    }
  ]
}
```

`output_resources[0].url` is a public CDN URL — no auth needed to download. `thumbnail_url` is a JPEG of the first frame for previews.

### Stop / continue

```
POST /v1/generations/{id}/stop       — full refund
POST /v1/generations/{id}/continue   — re-charge, resume
```

### Render failures

On `status: "failed"`, `failed_reason` contains a user-facing message. Credits are fully refunded. Retry by calling `POST /render` again — a new generation_id is returned.

### Listing past renders for an engine (via content resources)

All render outputs are content resources on the agent, filterable by type:

```
GET /v1/content_resources?agent_id={id}&type=video
```

## Download

```
curl -L -o final_video.mp4 "https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/render_xyz.mp4"
```

CDN URLs are public and permanent until you explicitly delete the content resource. Individual layer outputs are also downloadable via each layer's `default_user_job.output_resources[0].url`.

## Publish to Social

Platforms: TikTok, Instagram, Facebook Page, YouTube, X, LinkedIn. One request can target several. Every request is validated per platform BEFORE queueing (media type/count, caption + title limits, required fields) and the outcome per platform — including the live `post_url` — is read back from the status endpoint. The agent must have connected the platform first (GEN app Setup → Accounts, or MCP `gen_discover` domain=`publish` view=`connect_url` / view=`connections`).

TikTok is private-only until GEN's TikTok app passes TikTok's app review: send `tiktok_privacy_level: "SELF_ONLY"` (Only me) — any other level is refused before queueing with 422 `error_code: "tiktok_private_only"`, and the creator-info lookup behind the privacy picker returns `privacy_level_options: ["SELF_ONLY"]` with a `privacy_restriction_reason`.

| Platform | `platform` | Content | Media/post | Caption limit | Title | Notes |
|----------|------------|---------|-----------|---------------|-------|-------|
| TikTok | `tiktok` | one video or image | 1 | 2,200 | ignored | privacy level + interaction flags required by TikTok |
| Instagram | `instagram` | one video (Reel), one image, or a 2-10 item carousel (images + videos) | 10 | 2,200 | ignored | ≤30 hashtags; `instagram_music` mixes a track under video items |
| Facebook Page | `facebook` | one video | 1 | 63,206 | 255 | posts to the connected Page |
| YouTube | `youtube` | one video | 1 | 5,000 | 100, **required** | `thumbnail_url` uploaded as the thumbnail (https .jpg/.png <2 MB); `youtube_options` visibility/shorts/tags/made_for_kids/notify_subscribers/category_id |
| X | `x` | text, up to 4 images, or one video; threads, replies | 4 | 280/tweet | ignored | text-only allowed |
| LinkedIn | `linkedin` | text, one video, 1-9 images (grid, or carousel = PDF built from them with `linkedin_options.carousel`), or one document (PDF/PPT/PPTX/DOC/DOCX) | 9 | 3,000 | 400 | text-only allowed; images + video -> images posted, video in `warning`; document exclusive; `linkedin_options` visibility/alt_text/carousel |

### Platform rules (live, no auth)

```
GET /v1/schedule/platforms
→ { "platforms": [ { "platform": "linkedin", "label": "LinkedIn", "text_only": true, "media": ["video","image","document"],
      "max_media_items": 9, "max_text": 3000, "max_title": 400, "required": [], "optional": [...], "ignored": [...],
      "options": { "linkedin_options": { "visibility": "public (default) | connections | loggedin", "alt_text": "string[] ..." } }, "notes": "..." }, ... ] }
```

This is exactly what the API validates against (and what the MCP tool schemas derive from).

### Create a post

```
POST /v1/schedule/with-post
Headers: X-API-Key, Content-Type: application/json,
         Idempotency-Key (optional, ≤128 chars, unique per agent — a retry with the same key returns the original post),
         X-Timezone-Offset (optional, hours from UTC, e.g. -7 — how times are rendered in the response)
Body:
{
  "agent_id": "<agent_id>",
  "platform": ["youtube", "x"],                 // tiktok | instagram | facebook | youtube | x | linkedin
  "schedule_type": "now",                       // now | specific_time | next_available (default)
  "scheduled_time": "2026-09-20T15:00:00Z",     // ISO 8601 UTC; required for specific_time; future
  "media_type": "VIDEO",                        // VIDEO (default) | IMAGE | REELS | TWEET_VIDEO
  "media_url": "https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/render_xyz.mp4",   // first/only media: video, image, or (LinkedIn) PDF/PPT/PPTX/DOC/DOCX
  "media_urls": ["..."],                        // more media: Instagram 2-10 total = carousel; X ≤4 images; LinkedIn ≤9 images; 1 elsewhere
  "title": "...",                               // YouTube required (≤100); Facebook ≤255; LinkedIn ≤400 (document title); ignored elsewhere
  "description": "caption #hashtags",           // per-platform limit above; required for text-only X/LinkedIn; Instagram ≤30 hashtags
  "thumbnail_url": "...",                       // optional; generated from the video when omitted; YouTube uploads it (https .jpg/.jpeg/.png, <2 MB)
  "instagram_music": { "mode": "auto" },        // Instagram only; or { "track_url": "https://...mp3" }; needs a video item
  "youtube_options": { "visibility": "public", "shorts": false, "tags": ["a","b"], "made_for_kids": false, "notify_subscribers": true, "category_id": 22 },
  "linkedin_options": { "visibility": "public", "alt_text": ["per image, in order"], "carousel": false },   // visibility: public | connections | loggedin; carousel: 2-9 images -> one PDF document (LinkedIn has no image carousel; several images render as a grid)
  "thread": [{ "text": "1/ ...", "media_urls": ["..."] }],   // X only, each ≤280 chars
  "reply_to_tweet_id": "178...",               // X only
  "tiktok_privacy_level": "SELF_ONLY",          // TikTok: SELF_ONLY only until the app review passes (other levels → 422 tiktok_private_only); after review PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE | MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS | FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR | SELF_ONLY
  "tiktok_disable_comment": false, "tiktok_disable_duet": false, "tiktok_disable_stitch": false,
  "tiktok_disclose_commercial_content": false, "tiktok_your_brand": false, "tiktok_branded_content": false,
  "strict": true                                // recommended: a platform that cannot take this content → 422 instead of a reported skip
}
→ {
  "post_id": 48213,
  "platforms": ["youtube", "x"],
  "platforms_status": [ { "platform": "youtube", "normalized_status": "publishing", "platform_post_id": null, "post_url": null, "published_at": null, "error": null, "error_code": null, "warning": null, "platform_options": {...}, ... }, ... ],
  "platforms_skipped": [],                      // [{ "platform", "reason" }] when strict=false and a platform cannot take the content
  "status_url": "/schedule/post/48213",
  "idempotent_replay": false,
  "post": { ... }
}
```

Publishing is asynchronous even for `now`: 200 = accepted and queued. Poll the status endpoint for the outcome.

Validation failure (422, before anything is queued):

```
{ "detail": { "error": "YouTube requires a title", "error_code": "platform_validation_failed",
              "platform": "youtube", "field": "title",
              "errors": [ { "platform": "youtube", "field": "title", "error": "YouTube requires a title" } ] } }
```

Checked: caption > max_text, title > max_title, missing YouTube title, too many media items (>10 Instagram, >4 images X, >9 images LinkedIn, >1 elsewhere), images on video-only platforms (Facebook, YouTube), documents anywhere but LinkedIn, LinkedIn mixing a document with other media (images + video: images posted, video in `warning`), >30 Instagram hashtags, `instagram_music` without a video item, bad YouTube `thumbnail_url` (not https, or a non .jpg/.jpeg/.png extension), bad option values (`youtube_options.visibility|tags|category_id`, `linkedin_options.visibility|alt_text`; `field` is dotted), tweet segments > 280, unknown platform; with `strict`, also no media on a media-only platform.

### Outcome + post link

```
GET /v1/schedule/post/{post_id}
→ { "id": 48213, "status": "success",
    "platforms_status": [
      { "platform": "youtube", "normalized_status": "published", "platform_post_id": "dQw4w9WgXcQ",
        "post_url": "https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ", "published_at": "2026-09-20T15:00:12Z", "error": null },
      { "platform": "instagram", "normalized_status": "failed", "post_url": null,
        "error": "Media download failed: 403 Forbidden", "error_code": "media_fetch_failed", "failed_step": "download" } ] }
```

`normalized_status`: `accepted` (stored) → `publishing` (scheduled / uploading) → `published` (live; `post_url` + `platform_post_id` set) | `failed` (`error`, `error_code`, `failed_step`). `post_url` is the public link: YouTube watch URL (or `/shorts/{id}` when `youtube_options.shorts`), Instagram permalink, Facebook Page video, TikTok video, X status, LinkedIn post. `warning` = non-fatal (e.g. YouTube `thumbnail_failed: ...`, video still live). Instagram reports the `music_track` used (or null).

### Post metrics

```
GET /v1/schedule/post/{post_id}/metrics
→ { "post_id": 48213, "platforms": [ { "platform": "tiktok", "status": "ok", "post_url": "https://www.tiktok.com/@u/video/7300",
      "metrics": { "views": 12050, "likes": 830, "comments": 42, "shares": 17 } },
    { "platform": "linkedin", "status": "unsupported", "post_url": null, "metrics": null } ] }
```

Per-platform `views`, `likes`, `comments`, `shares` for a post that went out, read from the destination platform — not from GEN's own analytics. `status`: `ok` (`metrics` are current) | `not_published` | `unsupported` (GEN cannot read that network's numbers; Facebook and LinkedIn) | `reauthorization_required` (reconnect the account) | `failed`. Counts are a live snapshot, so they move between calls. Over MCP: `gen_discover` domain=`publish` view=`metrics` with `post_id`.

### Calendar: list / update / delete

```
GET    /v1/schedule/posts?agent_id=&start_date=<ISO date>&end_date=<ISO date>   // window ≤ 60 days
PATCH  /v1/schedule/post/{post_id}   // same content fields as create + scheduled_time, schedule_type; only before it goes out
DELETE /v1/schedule/post/{post_id}
```

### Edit a post that is already live

```
PATCH /v1/schedule/post/{post_id}/published
{ "description": "Corrected sourcing figures in the pinned comment." }
→ { "post_id": 48213,
    "results": [ { "platform": "youtube", "platform_post_id": "dQw4w9WgXcQ", "result": "updated",
                   "updated_fields": ["description"], "quota_units": 50,
                   "metadata": { "title": "Factory price reveal", "description": "Corrected sourcing figures...",
                                 "tags": ["sourcing","beauty"], "category_id": 22 } } ] }
```

Editable fields per platform come from `editable_after_publish` in `GET /v1/schedule/platforms`. Today: **YouTube** `title` (≤100, not blank), `description` (≤5,000 **bytes**, not characters; explicit `null` clears it), `tags` (each 2+ chars, ≤400 chars total), `category_id` (positive int), and **LinkedIn** `description` (the commentary, rewritten in place with the Posts API PARTIAL_UPDATE). Every other platform is `[]` — TikTok, Instagram and Facebook have no post-publication edit for this content, and editing a sent tweet is a paid X plan feature.

**Sparse and idempotent.** Only the fields in the body change. GEN reads the platform's current metadata, merges the change onto it and writes it back, so an unsent title is never cleared and the same request twice converges rather than stacking. `metadata` is read back *from the platform* after the write, not echoed from the request.

`result` per platform: `updated` · `unsupported_after_publish` (that network has no edit path; nothing was touched — not an auth error) · `reauthorization_required` (GEN's saved authorization can no longer edit it; reconnect via GEN app → Setup → Accounts) · `failed` (`message` carries the platform's reason, e.g. `quotaExceeded`).

`422`: `post_not_published` (it has not gone out — use `PATCH /v1/schedule/post/{post_id}`), an empty body, or `platform_validation_failed` naming the `field` (a field the platform cannot change after publishing, or one over its limit). Each YouTube update costs 50 units of the connected channel's YouTube API quota.

### Upload media (upload_asset)

Posts reference media by URL (public at post time; a render URL works directly). Upload a local file to get a hosted URL, also saved to the agent's Assets.

```
POST /v1/social/upload_asset   (multipart/form-data)
Fields: file=<binary>, agent_id=<agent_id>
→ { "url": "https://cdn.gen.pro/...", "asset_id": "123", "content_resource_id": 123, "asset_registered": true }
```

### Recipes

```bash
# LinkedIn text-only, now
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/with-post" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"agent_id":"'$AGENT'","platform":["linkedin"],"schedule_type":"now","description":"Three things we learned this week...","strict":true}'

# YouTube, scheduled, idempotent
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/with-post" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Idempotency-Key: launch-2026-09-20" \
  -d '{"agent_id":"'$AGENT'","platform":["youtube"],"schedule_type":"specific_time","scheduled_time":"2026-09-20T15:00:00Z","media_url":"https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/render_xyz.mp4","title":"Factory price reveal","description":"...","strict":true}'

# Instagram carousel (2-10 items) with auto music
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/with-post" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"agent_id":"'$AGENT'","platform":["instagram"],"schedule_type":"now","media_url":"https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/clip_1.mp4","media_urls":["https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/still_2.jpg"],"description":"Two looks #drop","instagram_music":{"mode":"auto"},"strict":true}'

# YouTube Short, custom thumbnail, unlisted
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/with-post" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"agent_id":"'$AGENT'","platform":["youtube"],"schedule_type":"now","media_url":"https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/render_xyz.mp4","thumbnail_url":"https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/cover.jpg","title":"Factory price reveal","youtube_options":{"visibility":"unlisted","shorts":true,"tags":["sourcing"]},"strict":true}'

# LinkedIn PDF document, connections only
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/with-post" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"agent_id":"'$AGENT'","platform":["linkedin"],"schedule_type":"now","media_url":"https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/q3-deck.pdf","title":"Q3 in ten slides","description":"One slide at a time.","linkedin_options":{"visibility":"connections"},"strict":true}'

# X thread
curl -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/with-post" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"agent_id":"'$AGENT'","platform":["x"],"schedule_type":"now","thread":[{"text":"1/ launch thread"},{"text":"2/ with a pic","media_urls":["https://cdn.gen.pro/outputs/a.jpg"]},{"text":"3/ wrap up"}]}'

# Upload → post → read the link back
URL=$(curl -s -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/social/upload_asset" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -F "file=@image.jpg" -F "agent_id=$AGENT" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['url'])")
POST_ID=$(curl -s -X POST "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/with-post" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"agent_id\":\"$AGENT\",\"platform\":[\"x\"],\"schedule_type\":\"now\",\"media_type\":\"IMAGE\",\"media_urls\":[\"$URL\"],\"description\":\"hi\",\"strict\":true}" | python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin)['post_id'])")
curl -s "https://api.gen.pro/v1/schedule/post/$POST_ID" -H "X-API-Key: $KEY" | python3 -c "import sys,json; [print(p['platform'],p['normalized_status'],p['post_url'] or p['error']) for p in json.load(sys.stdin)['platforms_status']]"
```

X specifics: `thread` and `reply_to_tweet_id` are X-only and ignored elsewhere. A thread that fails partway stops at the failed segment, records the tweets already posted, and is marked failed (not retried, to avoid duplicates). One shared `description`/`title` across several platforms must fit the tightest limit in the list (X 280, YouTube title 100) — or send one request per platform.

Legacy: `POST /v1/user_jobs` with `user_job_type: publish_content` still posts a single TikTok video; poll `GET /v1/user_jobs/{id}` (`result.post_id`). New integrations should use `/v1/schedule/with-post`.

---

# Error Format

```json
{ "error": "Human-readable message", "error_code": "machine_code" }
```

| Status | Code | Meaning |
|--------|------|---------|
| 401 | `unauthorized` | missing or invalid API key |
| 403 | `forbidden` | no permission for this resource |
| 404 | `not_found` | resource doesn't exist |
| 422 | `usable_gen_credit_required` | no active credits |
| 422 | `agent_not_found` | invalid `agent_id` |
| 422 | `insufficient_credits_for_job` | not enough credits for this generation |
| 422 | `validation_error` | invalid request body |

## Common status codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 200 | Success |
| 201 | Resource created |
| 204 | Success, no content (used for deletes) |
| 207 | Multi-Status (partial success on PATCH /core) |
| 401 | Unauthorized |
| 403 | Forbidden |
| 404 | Not found |
| 422 | Validation / credits / business-rule error |

---

# Monitoring & Automation (Watchlists + Recurring Jobs)

Two long-running primitives let an agent watch the world and act on a
schedule. Both are CRUD-only here; downstream scrapes and scheduled runs bill
normally. Management calls (create/read/update/delete/pause/resume) are
**free**.

## Watchlists (`https://agent-core.gen.pro/v1`)

A `Watchlist` is a named collection of `(platform, target_type, target_value)`
sources. `target_type` is one of:

- `account` — a username/handle (e.g. `drunkelephant`)
- `hashtag` — a tag name (without `#`)
- `keyword` — free-text search phrase

Scraped results from these sources feed back into agent chat and content idea
generation. Query the results through the chat interface, not directly here.

### Watchlist endpoints

```
GET    /v1/agents/{agent_id}/watchlists
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/watchlists
GET    /v1/agents/{agent_id}/watchlists/{watchlist_id}
PATCH  /v1/agents/{agent_id}/watchlists/{watchlist_id}
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/watchlists/{watchlist_id}
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/watchlists/{watchlist_id}/sources
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/watchlists/{watchlist_id}/sources/{source_id}
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/watchlists/{watchlist_id}/sources?platform=&target_type=&target_value=
```

### Watchlist shapes

`WatchlistCreateRequest`:

```json
{
  "name": "crypto watch",
  "sources": [
    { "platform": "tiktok", "target_type": "keyword", "target_value": "btc" }
  ],
  "project_id": null,
  "conversation_id": null,
  "created_by_run_id": null
}
```

`Watchlist` response:

```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "user_id": "string",
  "agent_id": "uuid",
  "name": "crypto watch",
  "intent_active": true,
  "project_id": null,
  "project_error": null,
  "conversation_id": null,
  "created_by_run_id": null,
  "sources": [
    {
      "id": "uuid",
      "watchlist_id": "uuid",
      "agent_id": "uuid",
      "platform": "tiktok",
      "target_type": "keyword",
      "target_value": "btc",
      "original_display_value": null,
      "intent_active": true,
      "created_at": "2026-05-27T19:00:00Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-05-27T19:00:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "created_at": "2026-05-27T19:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-05-27T19:00:00Z"
}
```

### Watchlist semantics

- **`POST /watchlists` is idempotent on `name`** (case-insensitive within an
  agent). Re-posting the same name merges new sources into the existing
  watchlist instead of creating a duplicate.
- **Sources are unique by (`platform`, `target_type`, `target_value`)** within
  a watchlist. Re-adding an existing source returns the existing row,
  restoring it if it had been soft-deleted.
- **`PATCH /watchlists/:id` with `{"intent_active": false}`** is the pause
  primitive; `true` resumes. Use `DELETE` only to permanently retire.
- **`DELETE`** is a soft delete: rows are marked inactive and `deleted_at`
  is set; nothing is returned by subsequent `GET`/`list`.

### Querying a watchlist with typed filters (`https://agent.gen.pro/v1`)

Watchlist *analysis* runs through agent chat, not the agent-core CRUD surface.
The MCP action `gen_watchlist_action` `query_watchlist` takes the same ask as a typed parameter
object so you don't hand-build a prompt. It replaces the retired `gen_query_watchlist` tool: `gen_watchlist_action` is the `/v1/agent/run` call below
with a `@list:<watchlist_id>` reference; the
chat layer parses the filters and applies them byte-identically across all of
the watchlist's sources, and returns a `run_id`. Poll the run until
`status == "completed"`; the final answer payload carries a video-grid block
plus a natural-language summary that respects every filter.

```bash
# Equivalent to MCP: gen_watchlist_action action=query_watchlist (agent_id, watchlist_id,
#   question="top videos", limit=30, days=90, sort_by="engagement_rate")
curl -X POST "https://agent.gen.pro/v1/agent/run" \
  -H "X-API-Key: $GEN_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"agent_id\":\"$AGENT_ID\",\"message\":\"top 30 videos from @list:$WL_ID by engagement rate in the last 90 days\"}"
# → { "run_id": "run_abc", "status": "running", ... }
```

`gen_watchlist_action` `query_watchlist` typed fields (all optional except `question`):

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `question` | string (required) | Drives the analysis kind: `top videos` → trend_videos, `top hooks` → top_hooks, `top creators` → top_creators, `trending music` → top_sounds, `comment themes` → comment_themes, `stats` → engagement_summary. |
| `days` | int 1-365 | Time window. Out-of-range → chat clarifier, not a silent drop. |
| `limit` | int 1-1000 | Result count. Out-of-range → chat clarifier. |
| `sort_by` | `engagement_rate \| watch_count \| like_count \| comment_count \| share_count \| save_count \| posted_at \| trending_score` | Sort key. Omit for the backend's default ranking. |
| `min_engagement_rate` | number 0.0-1.0 | Fractional threshold (`0.05` = above 5%). |
| `return_all` | boolean | Walk every matching row up to the maximum of 1000. With no explicit `limit`, lifts the per-call ceiling; with `limit=N`, the explicit cap wins. |

**Filter semantics — no silent caps:** every stated filter is honored
byte-identically across all of the watchlist's sources. Omitted filters fall to a single default
policy applied in one place (`limit` → 100; `days` / `sort_by` /
`min_engagement_rate` stay unset so the backend's own behavior shows through).
Out-of-range values surface a chat clarifier rather than being silently
clamped or dropped.

## Recurring Jobs / Daily Tasks (`https://agent.gen.pro/v1`)

A `RecurringJob` runs a prompt on a schedule, optionally delivering results by
email. Lifecycle: `active` ↔ `paused`, terminal `deleted`. Each scheduled
run is gated by available credits — a job remains configured if the workspace
runs out of credits and resumes when credits return.

### Recurring-job endpoints

```
GET    /v1/agents/{agent_id}/recurring-jobs
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/recurring-jobs
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/recurring-jobs/defaults
GET    /v1/agents/{agent_id}/recurring-jobs/{job_id}
PATCH  /v1/agents/{agent_id}/recurring-jobs/{job_id}
DELETE /v1/agents/{agent_id}/recurring-jobs/{job_id}
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/recurring-jobs/{job_id}/pause
POST   /v1/agents/{agent_id}/recurring-jobs/{job_id}/resume
```

### Recurring-job shapes

`RecurringJobCreate`:

```json
{
  "name": "weekly retention digest",
  "job_type": "generate_content_ideas",
  "prompt": "Give me 5 retention-focused hook patterns this week",
  "schedule": {
    "cadence": "weekly",
    "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles",
    "time_of_day": "09:00",
    "days_of_week": [0]
  },
  "delivery": { "type": "email", "email": "you@example.com" },
  "next_run_at": "2026-06-03T16:00:00Z"
}
```

Fields:

- `name` — optional. Defaults to first 80 chars of `prompt`.
- `job_type` — `"generate_content_ideas"` is the default pipeline.
- `prompt` — natural-language instruction the agent runs each cycle.
- `schedule.cadence` ∈ `daily | weekly`.
- `schedule.timezone` — IANA timezone string.
- `schedule.time_of_day` — `"HH:MM"` 24h local time; required for
  `daily`/`weekly` cadences.
- `schedule.days_of_week` — array of ints 0-6 (0=Mon … 6=Sun). REQUIRED when
  `cadence` is `weekly`; must be omitted when `daily`. No duplicates.
- `delivery.type` ∈ `chat_only | email`.
- `delivery.email` — recipient address; REQUIRED when `type` is `email`, must
  be omitted when `chat_only`.
- `next_run_at` — ISO-8601 to schedule the first run explicitly; otherwise
  derived from cadence + time_of_day.

`RecurringJob` response:

```json
{
  "id": "uuid",
  "user_id": 11,
  "agent_id": "uuid",
  "name": "weekly retention digest",
  "job_type": "generate_content_ideas",
  "prompt": "Give me 5 retention-focused hook patterns this week",
  "schedule": { "cadence": "weekly", "timezone": "America/Los_Angeles", "time_of_day": "09:00", "days_of_week": [0] },
  "delivery": { "type": "email", "email": "you@example.com" },
  "status": "active",
  "next_run_at": "2026-06-03T16:00:00Z",
  "last_run_at": null,
  "created_at": "2026-05-27T19:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "2026-05-27T19:00:00Z"
}
```

### Defaults endpoint

`POST /v1/agents/{agent_id}/recurring-jobs/defaults` is idempotent: returns
the agent's existing default "Generate content ideas" job if one exists,
otherwise creates it with daily cadence at 09:00 UTC and `chat_only`
delivery.

```json
{
  "recurring_jobs": [ { ...RecurringJob } ],
  "created": true
}
```

### Pause / resume / delete

- `POST /recurring-jobs/:id/pause` → `status = "paused"`, scheduler stops
  queueing new runs. History and configuration preserved.
- `POST /recurring-jobs/:id/resume` → `status = "active"`.
- `DELETE /recurring-jobs/:id` → `status = "deleted"`, returns 204. Use
  pause for reversible stops.

### Credit semantics

The job *intention* is free to keep configured. Each scheduled *run* is
billed at execution time against existing `user_jobs` pricing for the
relevant `job_type`. If the workspace has no credits at fire time, the run
is skipped and the job remains scheduled — no automatic deletion, no email
delivered for that cycle. Credits returning resumes normal execution at the
next cadence tick.

---

# Integrations

- MCP Server: hosted remote endpoint `https://mcp.gen.pro` with `Authorization: Bearer <pat>` (`/mcp` also accepts older configurations). The downloadable package is retired. Use live `tools/list` for available tools and `gen://api-reference` for guidance.
<!-- gen:backend-mcp-tools:start -->

The hosted server serves 15 tools (`gen_discover` plus one `gen_<noun>_action` per domain, and the `gen_ask`, `gen_analyze`, `gen_avatars` and `gen_generate` tools):

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `gen_agent_action` | Manage assistants and their profiles. |
| `gen_analyze` | Analyze real social data and research the web: collect is the typed collection seam — one synchronous DW /collect call per request, answered as model-visible evidence + a per-target coverage summary… |
| `gen_ask` | Ask GEN anything in plain words: a question, or a build goal for the composer. |
| `gen_asset_action` | Manage the agent's asset library: analyze any asset_id or file url with kind video/image/audio (quoted, confirmed DW enrichment; documents are refused until DW supports them; cached repeats are… |
| `gen_avatars` | Avatars: one person each, with looks (images of the person) and talking loops (silent talking videos of the person, generated from a look or uploaded). |
| `gen_billing_action` | Buy GEN credits for a workspace: start a Stripe checkout (buy_credits) or create and settle an x402 crypto purchase (create_x402_credit_purchase, settle_x402_credit_purchase). |
| `gen_content_action` | Manage an agent's content: its content resource files — create one from an uploaded file (create_content_resource), rename one (update_content_resource), or permanently delete one… |
| `gen_discover` | Discover |
| `gen_generate` | Create media with GEN: generate an image (create_image), a video clip (create_video), an original song (create_song), a DJ-style song mix (create_song_mix), or transcribe audio or video into text… |
| `gen_platform_action` | Workspace and access admin for an agent: create, rename, or delete an organization (create_organization, update_organization, delete_organization), upgrade its workspace plan (upgrade_workspace)… |
| `gen_publish_action` | Step 5 (Export & Publish): Ship posts to social platforms — schedule, publish, update, or remove posts. |
| `gen_task_action` | Run the task control plane: create, update, pause, resume, delete, duplicate, and run-now recurring jobs ('daily tasks' — a schedule plus a saved prompt), manage content-monitoring jobs, and approve… |
| `gen_vidsheet_action` | Step 4 (Edit & Generate): the Vidsheet write tool for the editable video workspace. |
| `gen_voice_action` | Build a custom voice for an agent: clone one from an audio sample (clone_voice), design one from a scripted prompt flow (generate_voice_script, generate_voice_description, generate_voice_samples… |
| `gen_watchlist_action` | Run one or more watchlist operations in a single call: create, update, pause, resume or delete a watchlist, add or remove a monitoring source, or ask a question about a watchlist (query_watchlist… |

Retired `gen_*` names stay callable as hidden compatibility aliases (for example `gen_media_action` → `gen_generate`); the full map is https://api.gen.pro/changelog/2026-09-22-mcp-catalog-collapse/

<!-- gen:backend-mcp-tools:end -->
- MCP migration: Retired MCP tool names are hidden compatibility aliases until 2026-10-22 and answer with a `deprecation` pointer; the full legacy-name → replacement table is the migration guide: https://api.gen.pro/changelog/2026-09-22-mcp-catalog-collapse/
- MCP vs agent: The GEN API owns Vidsheet validation and persistence. MCP forwards `gen_vidsheet_action` to it; GEN chat plans over the same tools. `gen_discover` provides the current schema. Natural-language chat/research tools delegate to GEN's agent service; poll their `run_id` with the `gen_discover` run view (the retired `gen_get_run_status` name is a compatibility alias until 2026-10-22). Final-video rendering is unavailable through hosted MCP; use the Vidsheet editor. The four-host map and the composer boundary are stated once at https://api.gen.pro/guides/mcp/#hosts-and-the-composer-boundary.
- MCP payment recovery: low-credit failures return `status: "payment_required"`, `status_code: 402`, Stripe and x402 `payment_options`, and a same-call retry instruction. Payment requires approval. After funding succeeds, retry the same tool once with the same arguments; the funding result is not accepted or completed work.
- MCP sessions: `initialize` returns an `Mcp-Session-Id` scoped to the running deploy. After a deploy, an old id gets HTTP 404 with JSON-RPC error -32001; send `initialize`, then `tools/list` again. No session id = stateless. https://api.gen.pro/guides/mcp/#sessions-and-deploys
- MCP verified writes: every completed `gen_vidsheet_action` write returns `verified` (`changed`, `changes[]` with `verified_by` `read`|`receipt`, `unchecked`). A contradicted write fails with `WRITE_NOT_VERIFIED` and a `change_set_id` to undo. Report a change only from `verified`.
- MCP Reddit: Reddit is not supported; such calls are refused with `unsupported_platform` before billing.
- n8n: HTTP Request node with `X-API-Key` header
- OpenAPI 3.1: https://api.gen.pro/openapi.yaml  (every operation carries `x-phase`)
- Full Docs (5-step journey): https://api.gen.pro
- Teaching llms.txt: https://api.gen.pro/llms.txt
